final_message:
The bug was in `_eligible` in `billing/discounts.py`. The plan-restriction check read `price_id is None and plan_of.get(price_id) in plans`. That can never be true for a real line, so plan-restricted coupons discounted nothing. I changed it to `price_id is not None`.

The full suite now passes (25 tests), including the reproducing test. I added that test as `tests/test_discounts_plan.py`, and `answer.json` is written in the repo root.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -n "discount\|coupon" engine.py | head -50

sed -i 's/return price_id is None and plan_of/return price_id is not None and plan_of/' billing/discounts.py
echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}' > answer.json
cat >> tests/test_discounts_plan.py <<'E'
from billing import discounts


def test_plan_restricted_coupon(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "team", percent_off=5000, applies_to_plans=[world.team["id"]])
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1), (world.team_monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert [line["discount_amount"] for line in inv["lines"]] == [0, 1500]
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
